auth:access-control.definition: An authorization decision gating a resource by role, row ownership, group/tenant membership, or moderator status.

auth:api-token.definition: A bearer/API token credential for programmatic (non-interactive) access to an API.

auth:peer-identity.definition: The cryptographic identity of a remote node/peer (TOFU fingerprint, key) used to authenticate machine-to-machine links.

auth:session.definition: An interactive login session and its security lifecycle (CSRF, throttling, two-factor, session cookies).

auth:user-identity.definition: An authenticated end-user principal (who is logged in), handed to features that personalize or authorize per user.

config:auth-credentials.definition: Operator-supplied secrets/credentials for authenticating to an external service or auth/LLM backend.

config:backend-selection.definition: Which pluggable backend/provider to use for LLM, embedding, search, scraping, or storage.

config:browser-profile.definition: Headless-browser session and fingerprint settings (stealth, anti-bot).

config:concurrency-limit.definition: Caps on concurrent operations or request rate.

config:crawl-rules.definition: Crawl scope, robots handling, URL filters, and domain blocking rules.

config:domain-wildcard.definition: Domain, wildcard, and routing-domain settings for proxying or request filtering.

config:locale-settings.definition: Locale, timezone, and calendar formatting settings.

config:model-hyperparams.definition: ML model/training hyperparameters and architecture settings.

config:note-template.definition: A template or injected context block used to scaffold notes or agent prompts.

config:peer-identity.definition: Static peer/node identity and key material configured for a mesh/tunnel.

config:plugin-config.definition: Enablement, gating, and policy settings for plugins/modules/features.

config:port-mapping.definition: A network port-forwarding map between local and remote endpoints.

config:proxy-list.definition: A list of proxy servers to rotate outbound requests through.

config:retry-policy.definition: Retry and backoff policy settings (limits, intervals, jitter).

config:schedule.definition: Cron/interval/refresh schedule settings telling a runner when to fire.

config:service-endpoint.definition: The address/URL of a remote service (coordinator, room, tunnel, API) this component should dial.

config:service-list.definition: A configured list of services/apps/targets to monitor, integrate, or probe.

config:storage-path.definition: A filesystem path where the component reads or writes its data/state/locks.

config:threshold-config.definition: Alert/risk/scoring thresholds and signal weights the component compares against.

config:tls-certificate.definition: TLS certificate and private-key material supplied to serve or verify HTTPS/mTLS.

data:agent-context.definition: Bootstrap context/state injected into an agent at session start.

data:agent-routing.definition: A routing decision selecting which agent/profile handles a request.

data:agent-session.definition: A handle to a running agent/ACP session.

data:alert-config.definition: An alert-rule definition with notification routing.

data:browser-fingerprint.definition: A generated browser fingerprint and request headers for stealth fetching.

data:calendar-sources.definition: Aggregated calendar event sources for a view.

data:code-metrics.definition: Code-health and architecture metrics (radar, Gini, delivery, structural scores).

data:conversation-diff.definition: A diff/history of a conversation or git-native transcript.

data:crawl-results.definition: Pages/URLs discovered and queued by a crawl.

data:dashboard-content.definition: Extracted dashboard content/JSONPath results for context windows.

data:dashboard-schema.definition: A dashboard/widget schema describing panels and layout.

data:dead-code-report.definition: A report of unreferenced/dead code from reachability analysis.

data:disk-usage.definition: Disk-usage and cleanable-space measurements and cleanup results.

data:doc-health.definition: Documentation health, freshness, drift, and link-check results per section.

data:document-text.definition: Parsed document text and sections extracted from a file or page.

data:embedding-vector.definition: A semantic embedding vector for similarity/retrieval.

data:execution-result.definition: The result of running a command/module/pipeline step.

data:extracted-links.definition: Links/URLs harvested from content for crawling or enrichment.

data:feature-flags.definition: Capability/feature gating flags controlling exposed behavior.

data:http-client.definition: A configured HTTP client/transport-middleware chain for requests.

data:http-response.definition: An HTTP response payload returned from a fetch.

data:icon-catalog.definition: A catalog of icons from one or more sources.

data:implementation-plan.definition: A build/implementation plan or spec decomposed into steps.

data:import-graph.definition: A code import/dependency graph for structural analysis.

data:live-url-list.definition: URLs confirmed live by HTTP probing.

data:llm-adapter.definition: A pluggable LLM/embedding provider adapter handle.

data:llm-response.definition: An LLM completion/tool response for downstream use.

data:machine-info.definition: Machine fingerprint/identity and binary detection info.

data:market-price.definition: Market price/quote, fair value, sensitivity, and history data.

data:model-output.definition: Inference output or fitted coefficients/statistics from an ML/quant model.

data:next-run-time.definition: The next computed fire time for a scheduled job.

data:note-tags.definition: The frontmatter tags extracted for a specific note.

data:page-screenshot.definition: A rendered screenshot of a web page.

data:parsed-expense.definition: A parsed expense/transaction entry from quick-add input.

data:portfolio-positions.definition: Current portfolio holdings and risk exposure.

data:proxy-config.definition: Proxy configuration/rotation state for outbound requests.

data:recurrence-schedule.definition: Computed recurrence occurrences projected from a rule.

data:scored-memory.definition: Memory/retrieval results with confidence/importance scores and regret signals.

data:scraped-page.definition: Fetched/scraped web page content extracted from a URL.

data:search-results.definition: Ranked search/query results handed to a UI or caller.

data:service-status.definition: A health/status feed describing whether monitored services are up.

data:skill-definition.definition: A skill/slash-command definition with its metadata.

data:structured-extract.definition: Structured JSON extracted from unstructured input via an LLM.

data:system-metrics.definition: Collected system/performance metric samples and time series.

data:tag-catalog.definition: The catalog of tags available across content.

data:task-dependency.definition: A task dependency DAG with a ready queue.

data:task-status.definition: The runtime status/state of a task, job, or queue.

data:trade-decision.definition: A trade decision/proposal including risk and arbitrage opportunities.

data:tunnel-connection.definition: An established tunnel connection (SSH/QUIC/WebSocket) to relay traffic.

data:url-risk-status.definition: A risk/threat verdict for a URL or resource.

data:virtual-network.definition: An overlay/virtual network of connected peers.

data:workflow-config.definition: A workflow/pipeline definition loaded from config.

event:agent-response.definition: Fires when an agent produces a response/turn to be consumed or injected.

event:agent-started.definition: Fires when an agent run/session/turn begins, for bootstrap or context injection.

event:alert-raised.definition: Fires when a threshold breach, process alert, or config drift triggers an alert.

event:file-changed.definition: Fires when a file/document is added, deleted, indexed, scanned, or crawled.

event:input-event.definition: A user input / UI interaction event (click, key, clipboard, reorder, open).

event:knowledge-published.definition: Fires when new knowledge/document output is published to downstream integrations.

event:message-created.definition: Fires when a chat/room/channel message is created, for consumers that process or fan out messages.

event:metric-recorded.definition: Fires when a telemetry metric/trace is recorded, for observability consumers.

event:plugin-hook.definition: A plugin/extension hook point dispatched for registered handlers.

event:price-update.definition: Fires when a market price/quote updates.

event:service-down.definition: Fires when a monitored service is detected down/unhealthy.

event:service-up.definition: Fires when a monitored service recovers to healthy.

event:task-updated.definition: Fires when a task/job/state-machine changes state or completes.

event:trade-executed.definition: Fires when a trade/order is executed.

event:trade-signal.definition: Fires when a trading strategy emits a buy/sell signal.

event:verification-passed.definition: Fires when a gate/test/spec verification passes, allowing a workflow to proceed.

http:api-server.definition: An HTTP server/router exposing application endpoints.

http:media-stream.definition: An HTTP endpoint that streams media (audio/video) with transcoding or live metadata.

http:outbound-client.definition: An outbound HTTP client feature that calls external services on the app's behalf.

http:reverse-proxy.definition: A reverse proxy / tunnel relay / subdomain router forwarding inbound traffic to a backend.

http:status-endpoint.definition: A health/status HTTP endpoint reporting liveness and component state.

notify:push.definition: Delivers a push/remote notification to a user or device.

schedule:event-loop.definition: An async event loop / reactor driving event-driven or long-running agent work.

schedule:periodic-job.definition: A recurring scheduled job/cron runner that fires work on an interval.

store:audit-log.definition: An append-only audit/activity/operation log of what happened.

store:brain-registry.definition: A multi-tenant registry of isolated brains/workspaces.

store:cache.definition: A general-purpose cache of computed/fetched values keyed for reuse.

store:conversation-messages.definition: Stored chat/message history for rooms or conversations.

store:crawl-state.definition: A crawler's frontier/queue and visited state.

store:database.definition: A general database connection/engine backing application tables.

store:document-registry.definition: A collection of documents/notes/wiki/spec pages with versions.

store:file-attachments.definition: A store of binary file attachments.

store:file-lock.definition: Advisory file/record lock state (exclusive or reader-writer) for mutual exclusion.

store:layout-config.definition: Persisted dashboard/UI layout and tile-position configuration.

store:market-relationships.definition: A graph of relationships between tradable markets/instruments.

store:media-library.definition: A catalog of media items (songs, podcasts, stations, playlists) and now-playing state.

store:memory-graph.definition: A knowledge/memory graph of nodes and typed edges.

store:node-registry.definition: A registry of peers/nodes/machines/agents participating in a network.

store:recurrence-config.definition: Stored recurrence rules and recurring entries (bills, notes, events).

store:room-registry.definition: A registry of rooms/channels and their participants.

store:search-index.definition: A full-text / semantic / symbol / section index queried for retrieval.

store:service-registry.definition: A registry of services/apps/integrations with their endpoints and metadata.

store:session-registry.definition: Active runtime sessions/workspaces with idle/TTL lifecycle.

store:snapshot-records.definition: Saved snapshots/checkpoints of state, models, or runs for restore.

store:task-graph.definition: A task DAG / task list / progress ledger of ready and pending work.

store:ticket-registry.definition: A tracker of tickets/issues/cycles and their relationships.

store:trade-history.definition: A record of executed trades and portfolio positions over time.

store:user-registry.definition: An account store of users, credentials, login attempts, and subscriptions.

ui:calendar-panel.definition: A calendar/month-grid view of dated events.

ui:cli-tool.definition: A command-line / TUI interface with help, menus, and log output.

ui:dashboard-panel.definition: A status/diagnostics panel rendering live metrics or room/service state.

ui:graph-view.definition: A node/edge or DAG graph visualization surface.

ui:media-player.definition: An audio/video player UI including visualizers and offline playback.

ui:picker.definition: A modal picker/selector (icons, colors, fuzzy search).

ui:tile-grid.definition: A draggable grid of tiles/cards for a dashboard home.

ui:web-shell.definition: The web application page shell/layout that hosts feature views.
